note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate are all described; the ratio of mandible length to head length appears in the source OCR as O.47 (a letter for zero) and is not recorded; the lectotype measurement table, synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier mandibles stout, sickle-shaped; pronotum deeply notched medially on both the anterior and the posterior margin. Alate antennae 19-segmented, fore wing length 22.0–24.0 mm. Worker dimorphic.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown to dark brown; labrum light brown; antennae brownish, paler at the base; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; body and legs yellowish white to dirty yellow. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length 3.5–5.75 mm. Head capsule oval, sides weakly convex and slightly narrowing anteriorly, widest at the middle (length to mandibular base 1.13–1.60 mm, maximum width 0.90–1.25 mm, width at mandibular base 0.65–0.70 mm; ratio of maximum width to length 0.76–0.89, cephalic convergence index, i.e. width at mandibular base / maximum width, 0.644–0.679). Antennae 16–17-segmented; segment 3 shortest in the 16-segmented antenna, segment 4 shortest in the 17-segmented one, segment 4 sometimes in process of division. Labrum broadly ligulate, with a row of setae on each side (7 per side in the holotype); sides nearly parallel; anterior margin rounded, with a small point (length 0.18–0.30 mm, width 0.25–0.35 mm). Mandibles short and stout, sickle-shaped, apices incurved; shorter than to slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.60–0.75 mm). Proximal half of the left mandible with 3 small denticles and one basal tooth. Right mandible without denticles, or with a single small denticle slightly below the middle. Postmentum subquadrate, sides nearly parallel or very weakly incurved (length 0.60–0.90 mm, maximum width 0.35–0.50 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin deeply notched medially; posterior margin also deeply notched (length 0.40–0.58 mm, width 0.70–0.90 mm). Mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, metanotum about as wide as or slightly wider than the pronotum; posterior margins of both nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule brown; antennae dark straw to brown, paler at the base; postclypeus straw to brownish yellow; abdomen and legs pale yellow. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 3.0–5.65 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.35–1.40 mm, maximum width 1.4–1.53 mm). Antennae 16–18-segmented; basal segments variable in size (segment 4 shortest in the 18-segmented paratype). Postclypeus inflated, hairy; less than half as long as wide (paratype length 0.30–0.33 mm, width 0.70–0.73 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin deeply notched, posterior margin distinctly incurved (length 0.40–0.45 mm, width 0.73–0.85 mm; paratype 0.40–0.45 mm and 0.73–0.78 mm respectively). Minor worker: as the major worker but smaller. Body length 3.6–4.3 mm, head length to mandibular base 0.75–1.20 mm, maximum head width 0.83–1.25 mm, pronotum length 0.30–0.40 mm, width 0.55–0.65 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; postclypeus yellow; antennae brown; pronotum brown with a yellow T-shaped mark medially and yellow patches on the shoulders; abdomen brown above and below but much paler medially; wings yellowish brown, with cuticular rods on the membrane and radial veinlets. Densely hairy. Body length including wings 26.0–27.0 mm, excluding wings 10.0–12.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.56–1.88 mm, maximum width including compound eyes 2.23–2.35 mm). Fontanelle a small, round, whitish spot, not raised. Compound eyes large, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.62–0.70 mm, minimum diameter 0.54–0.59 mm). Ocellus large, elliptical, semi-transparent; separated from the compound eye by about its short diameter (long diameter 0.32–0.33 mm, short diameter 0.23–0.28 mm, ocellus–compound eye distance 0.20–0.25 mm). Antennae 19-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 longer than segment 3 and shorter than segment 2; segment 5 equal in length to segment 3. Postclypeus large and inflated, less than half as long as wide (length 0.40–0.43 mm, width 0.90–0.95 mm). Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (length 1.05–1.14 mm, width 2.10–2.26 mm); anterior margin slightly raised, weakly notched medially; posterior margin nearly straight, slightly incurved medially. Wings yellowish brown, the membrane with fine obesus-type cuticular rods, hairy near the apex (fore wing length 22.0–24.0 mm). Media branched near the middle; cubitus with 12–16 branches.
